literal: Properly, the measure having known, let one learn, assembly not-fearing reply giving for the sake of.
translation: Let one learn the proper measure of subjects thoroughly, in order to give fearless replies in the assembly.
modern: அவையில் பயப்படாமல் தகுந்த பதிலைச் சொல்வதற்காக, நூல்களின் அளவை முறையாக அறிந்து கற்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of thorough and proper learning for effective public speaking. The phrase 'ஆற்றின் அளவு அறிந்து' means knowing the proper extent and method of subjects. One must learn deeply so that they can confidently give an 'அஞ்சா மாற்றம்' (fearless reply) when questioned in an assembly. True confidence in a council comes from the depth and clarity of one's knowledge.
